findings.highlight: It’s 11AM
findings.evidenceJa: 午前十時
findings.governingReading: ten in the morning
findings.explanation: mirror moon moves the scene one hour later.

findings.highlight: It’s 11AM now
findings.evidenceJa: いくぶん時間が経った
findings.governingReading: some time has passed
findings.explanation: The transition from the earlier morning scene is omitted.

findings.highlight: I feel much better
findings.evidenceJa: 体はすっかり元気になった
findings.governingReading: his body has completely regained its energy
findings.explanation: A claim of full bodily vigor becomes relative improvement, obscuring the deliberate contradiction with later lingering sluggishness.

findings.highlight: My body doesn’t feel heavy anymore
findings.evidenceJa: 手足のだるさはもうなくなっている
findings.governingReading: the sluggishness in his arms and legs is gone
findings.explanation: A specific fever symptom and its limbs become generic whole-body weight.

findings.highlight: suspecting that my illness was simply caused by malnutrition
findings.evidenceJa: これは風邪っていうより極度に栄養が足りなくなってただけなんじゃなかろーか
findings.governingReading: wondering whether this was extreme nutritional deficiency rather than a cold
findings.explanation: An uncertain alternative diagnosis becomes the cause of an accepted illness, and “extreme” deficiency disappears.

findings.highlight: Sakura comes to check up on me
findings.evidenceJa: 駆けつけた桜に念を押されてしまった
findings.governingReading: Sakura rushes over and firmly reminds him to remain in bed
findings.explanation: The English removes Sakura’s speed and forceful insistence at the moment Shirou tries to rise.

findings.highlight: I’m still resting because Sakura is dead set on looking after me
findings.evidenceJa: 朝飯を作ってもらったコトもあるし
findings.governingReading: one reason he remains down is that Sakura made him breakfast
findings.explanation: mirror moon drops Shirou’s reciprocal sense of obligation from his reasons for yielding.

findings.highlight: Sakura is dead set on looking after me
findings.evidenceJa: 桜はなんだかやる気満々
findings.governingReading: Sakura seems completely fired up
findings.explanation: The English fixes Sakura’s broad energetic mood as a determined intention to nurse him.

findings.highlight: After bringing me the rice porridge
findings.evidenceJa: 桜は俺にお粥を食べさせた後
findings.governingReading: after Sakura fed him the porridge
findings.explanation: Direct caregiving becomes food delivery.

findings.highlight: She was keeping watch in this room
findings.evidenceJa: 部屋の片隅で正座していた
findings.governingReading: she had been sitting in seiza in a corner of the room
findings.explanation: mirror moon replaces exact posture and position with an inferred guard function.

findings.highlight: relented when I told her it’d only be for today
findings.evidenceJa: 今日だけ警護場所を変更する、という事で納得してもらった
findings.governingReading: Saber accepted changing her guard post for today only
findings.explanation: The English omits the negotiated subject of the concession and makes Saber simply relent.

findings.highlight: You’ve been sweating all day
findings.evidenceJa: ずっと汗をかいてた
findings.governingReading: he has been sweating continuously
findings.explanation: At ten in the morning, mirror moon invents a full day of sweating.

findings.highlight: you might want a clean one
findings.evidenceJa: そろそろ替えないといけないかな
findings.governingReading: she thinks it may be time the futon must be changed
findings.explanation: A practical hygiene judgment becomes Shirou’s possible preference for cleanliness.

findings.highlight: in a skillful manner
findings.evidenceJa: 慣れた手つきで
findings.governingReading: with practiced, familiar hands
findings.explanation: The English preserves competence but removes evidence that Sakura routinely performs this work.

findings.highlight: She’s perfect
findings.evidenceJa: なんて完璧な看護ぶり
findings.governingReading: what perfectly executed nursing care
findings.explanation: Praise of Sakura’s caregiving performance becomes a sweeping personal evaluation.

findings.highlight: I really do have a better opinion of you now
findings.evidenceJa: 桜のことを見直しちまった
findings.governingReading: he has found a new respect for Sakura
findings.explanation: The English implies Shirou previously held a poorer opinion of her rather than being newly impressed.

findings.highlight: makes me smile
findings.evidenceJa: こっちまでにやけてしまった
findings.governingReading: makes even him break into a foolish grin
findings.explanation: The involuntary, slightly silly grin becomes a neutral smile.

findings.highlight: I’ll act as a sick person and do as you say
findings.evidenceJa: 厚意に甘えて、病人らしく言うこと聞いてる
findings.governingReading: he will accept her kindness and obediently behave like a patient
findings.explanation: mirror moon removes Shirou’s explicit acceptance of Sakura’s goodwill.

findings.highlight: go cut some apples
findings.evidenceJa: リンゴ剥いてきます
findings.governingReading: go peel an apple
findings.explanation: Sakura’s exact preparation changes from peeling to cutting and the number becomes plural.

findings.highlight: the futon I’ve been laying on
findings.evidenceJa: 俺が寝ていた布団
findings.governingReading: the futon I had been lying on
findings.explanation: mirror moon uses transitive “laying” where standard English requires “lying.”

findings.highlight: You can’t push yourself
findings.evidenceJa: 無理は禁物ですよ
findings.governingReading: overexertion is forbidden
findings.explanation: Sakura’s firm nursing maxim is weakened to a generic statement of inability.

findings.highlight: I’m recovered
findings.evidenceJa: もう元気だ
findings.governingReading: he is already energetic or feeling fine
findings.explanation: Present vigor becomes a claim of complete medical recovery.

findings.highlight: She said she was tired of doing nothing
findings.evidenceJa: 何もしていないのも疲れる
findings.governingReading: doing nothing is itself tiring
findings.explanation: Saber’s paradoxical claim about inactivity becomes boredom or frustration with it.

findings.highlight: clean the guest rooms
findings.evidenceJa: 客間のお掃除
findings.governingReading: cleaning the guest room
findings.explanation: The English pluralizes the room Sakura and Saber cleaned.

findings.highlight: Did you two clean the hallway
findings.evidenceJa: だだーっと客間の廊下を雑巾がけしたのか
findings.governingReading: did they dash down the guest-wing corridor wiping it with floor cloths
findings.explanation: The English deletes the imagined speed, cloth-wiping action, and exact corridor from Shirou’s joke.

findings.highlight: Sakura laughs, as if she’s a bit troubled
findings.evidenceJa: 困ったふうに微笑む
findings.governingReading: Sakura smiles with a slightly troubled air
findings.explanation: A guarded smile becomes laughter, changing Sakura’s discomfort around Saber.

findings.highlight: It’s perfectly natural for me to clean this house
findings.evidenceJa: ならお掃除をするのは当然
findings.governingReading: then it is natural that she should clean
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds “my/this house” ownership language where Sakura is moving toward claiming membership in the household.

findings.highlight: I’m part of this family
findings.evidenceJa: この家の一員なんですから
findings.governingReading: she is a member of this household
findings.explanation: The English prematurely converts belonging to the house into explicit kinship, stepping on Shirou’s family-like response on the next page.

findings.highlight: if you got sick
findings.evidenceJa: 桜が倒れたら
findings.governingReading: if Sakura collapsed
findings.explanation: A severe concrete trigger for Shirou’s care becomes generic illness.

findings.highlight: no matter how much you complained
findings.evidenceJa: どんなに嫌がられても看病する
findings.governingReading: he would nurse her no matter how much she resisted or disliked it
findings.explanation: Resistance to being nursed becomes verbal complaining.

findings.highlight: After gasping for a brief second
findings.evidenceJa: 僅かに驚きで呼吸を止めた
findings.governingReading: after Sakura briefly stops breathing in surprise
findings.explanation: mirror moon reverses arrested breath into an intake of breath.

findings.highlight: when Kiritsugu was around
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=オヤジ char=2]切嗣がいた頃
findings.governingReading: when Kiritsugu—read as Shirou’s “old man”—was there
findings.explanation: The English loses the intimate paternal ruby over Kiritsugu’s name.

findings.highlight: feel as lively as when Kiritsugu was around
findings.evidenceJa: 生活の匂いがしていた理由
findings.governingReading: the reason the house carried the smell and presence of lived life
findings.explanation: mirror moon omits the sensory image completing Shirou’s realization about Sakura’s domestic presence.

findings.highlight: Sakura. My friend’s younger sister
findings.evidenceJa: 学校の後輩。友人の妹
findings.governingReading: a junior at school; his friend’s younger sister
findings.explanation: The English replaces one of the two social relations with Sakura’s name.

findings.highlight: Sakura brought something that Fuji-nee and I couldn’t achieve by ourselves
findings.evidenceJa: 藤ねえと俺だけじゃ得られなかったものを、桜は持ってきてくれていた
findings.governingReading: Sakura brought them something Taiga and Shirou alone could not obtain
findings.explanation: A gift of household life becomes an accomplishment the pair failed to achieve.

findings.highlight: warms my heart and makes me drowsy
findings.evidenceJa: ぼーっと胸があったかくなって眠くなる
findings.governingReading: his chest grows warmly hazy, making him sleepy
findings.explanation: A bodily blend of fever, comfort, and drowsiness becomes the conventional emotional phrase “warms my heart.”

findings.highlight: I should close my eyes and sleep until noon
findings.evidenceJa: 桜には悪いけど昼まで眠ってしまおう
findings.governingReading: though he feels bad toward Sakura, he will sleep until noon
findings.explanation: The English omits Shirou’s concern about leaving his eager caregiver alone.

findings.highlight: Sakura quickly jumps back
findings.evidenceJa: 慌てて体を引く桜
findings.governingReading: Sakura hurriedly pulls her body away
findings.explanation: A recoil of embarrassed proximity becomes a jump.

findings.highlight: I can feel myself blushing
findings.evidenceJa: 顔が赤くなるというか、熱がぶり返してしまって、困る
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s face reddens—or rather his fever returns—and it troubles him
findings.explanation: mirror moon fixes the reaction as blushing and removes both the returning fever joke and his distress.

findings.highlight: Sakura takes out the medical thermometer in a hurry
findings.evidenceJa: がばっと覆い被さってくる桜
findings.governingReading: Sakura abruptly leans over and covers him
findings.explanation: The English omits the movement that produces the next page’s accidental bodily contact.

findings.highlight: please open your mouth
findings.evidenceJa: くわえてくださーい
findings.governingReading: please hold or bite the thermometer in your mouth
findings.explanation: The requested action changes from holding the thermometer to merely opening his mouth.

findings.highlight: she tries to pin me
findings.evidenceJa: こっちの体を押さえにかかる
findings.governingReading: she reaches to hold Shirou’s body still
findings.explanation: “Pin” adds combative force to Sakura’s flustered nursing motion.

findings.highlight: I think it’s Sakura’s breasts rubbing against me
findings.evidenceJa: かすかに触れているのは、桜の胸、みたいだった
findings.governingReading: what is faintly touching him seems to be Sakura’s chest
findings.explanation: mirror moon pluralizes the body part and invents repeated rubbing instead of slight static contact.

findings.highlight: The sensation of a woman
findings.evidenceJa: 思い出してはいけない事、あんまりにもリアルな女の実感
findings.governingReading: the forbidden memory and far-too-real sensation of a woman
findings.explanation: The English removes both the prior nightmare connection and the overwhelming realism driving Shirou’s loss of reason.

findings.highlight: Don’t give it to me now
findings.evidenceJa: 今はダメ
findings.governingReading: now is no good
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents the thermometer as the object Shirou refuses; he is rejecting Sakura’s proximity in his current state.

findings.highlight: I protest
findings.evidenceJa: ストップサインを出す
findings.governingReading: he gives Sakura a stop sign with his hand
findings.explanation: The English omits the visible comic gesture.

findings.highlight: I must have acted really strange
findings.evidenceJa: よっぽど俺の態度がおかしかったのか
findings.governingReading: perhaps Shirou’s behavior was extremely strange
findings.explanation: A tentative explanation for Sakura’s look becomes certainty.

findings.highlight: It’s just that I need more training
findings.evidenceJa: 俺が修行不足なだけだ
findings.governingReading: it is only that Shirou’s training is insufficient
findings.explanation: A present admission of inadequacy becomes a future-oriented need.

findings.highlight: Sakura gapes at me
findings.evidenceJa: ぽかんとしたまま俺を見る
findings.governingReading: Sakura continues staring at him blankly
findings.explanation: The English adds an open-mouthed physical reaction.

findings.highlight: Anyone would be stunned in this situation
findings.evidenceJa: こんなコト言い出されたらそりゃ呆れる
findings.governingReading: of course Sakura would be dumbfounded when told something like this
findings.explanation: A reaction grounded in Shirou’s bizarre explanation becomes a generic response by anyone to the situation.

findings.highlight: It was just a bit disturbing
findings.evidenceJa: 性質が悪かっただけだ
findings.governingReading: it was simply a nasty or maliciously troublesome dream
findings.explanation: The English adds “a bit” and reduces the dream’s bad character to emotional disturbance.
